gloss: masterful skill; virtuoso performance; expert technique

definitions.gloss: masterful skill; virtuoso performance; expert technique
definitions.explanation: an exceptionally skilled performance or technique that only a master could pull off

examples.japanese: まさに{名人芸|めいじんげい}だ。
あの{職人|しょくにん}の{包丁|ほうちょう}さばきは{名人芸|めいじんげい}だ。
examples.english: That craftsman's knife work is a display of masterful skill.

examples.japanese: {長年|ながねん}の{経験|けいけん}に{裏打|うらう}ちされた{名人芸|めいじんげい}で、{複雑|ふくざつ}な{修理|しゅうり}をあっという{間|ま}にやってのけた。
examples.english: Backed by years of experience, he completed the complex repair in no time with masterful skill.

notes:
Describes an extraordinary skill that appears effortless but is the product of deep expertise. Often used admiringly for traditional craftspeople, performers, athletes, and professionals whose technique is so refined it seems almost magical.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- まさに{名人芸|めいじんげい}: truly a masterful feat
- {名人芸|めいじんげい}を{見|み}せる: to demonstrate masterful skill
- {名人芸|めいじんげい}と{言|い}える: can be called a virtuoso performance

ETYMOLOGY:
Composed of {名人|めいじん} (master, expert) and {芸|げい} (art, skill, performance). Literally, an art that only a master can perform.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {職人芸|しょくにんげい}: artisan's craft — similar but specifically about manual craftsmanship
- {匠|たくみ}の{技|わざ}: master's technique — more literary, often used in media about traditional crafts
- {神業|かみわざ}: godlike skill — even more extreme praise, implying something almost superhuman
